scope: Full product plan; packages only verified after specified acceptance

packages.name: Product and contracts
packages.deliverables: Supported app categories, API contract, policy envelope, architecture decisions, provenance rules
packages.acceptance: Approved specification; no competitor code in dependencies/templates; customer interviews recorded.
packages.remaining: Original contracts and provenance guardrails exist; customer interviews, approved product/legal/policy envelope and independent provenance review remain open.

packages.name: Toolchain and local build
packages.deliverables: Signed version lock, SDK installation, doctor, native project generation, local CI
packages.acceptance: Clean machine builds FieldLog for both targets with reproducible input graph.
packages.remaining: CLI creation/locked source export and generated iOS consumer work locally. Signed toolchain distributions, Android project generation, clean-machine immutable package builds and full FieldLog graph remain open.

packages.name: Core Swift model
packages.deliverables: Lifecycle, state, effects, navigation model, resources, errors
packages.acceptance: Same state/effect tests in native targets; restoration works.
packages.remaining: Bounded core/state/effects/resource/navigation values and strict UI codecs are tested; full lifecycle/restoration, platform parity and public adoption remain open.

packages.name: iOS UI adapter
packages.deliverables: Public MixerUI implementation, SwiftUI/UIKit mapping, input and accessibility
packages.acceptance: D1 and UI matrix pass on physical iOS.
packages.remaining: Generated iOS native renderer runs in a simulator. Physical engine-based FieldLog D1, full UI/navigation matrix and accessibility remain open.

packages.name: Android UI adapter
packages.deliverables: JNI boundary, Compose/native controls, lifecycle, back behavior, native resources
packages.acceptance: D2 with native Android interaction and accessibility evidence.
packages.remaining: Physical Pixel Swift/JNI/native widget interactions pass for a checklist slice. FieldLog D2, published SDK use, process restoration, full UI/IME/TalkBack/device/performance matrices remain open.

packages.name: Capability generator
packages.deliverables: Schema, generated adapters, ownership/cancellation, permission metadata
packages.acceptance: Cross-language codec and lifecycle suite; first native plugin consumed by FieldLog.
packages.remaining: Typed HTTP/storage schema, generated Swift/Java adapters, grant intersection and bounded host/storage lifecycle pass host codecs and cross-compilation. Reopen quotas are independently checked. Signed per-release grants, real guest/JNI transport, physical permission/lifecycle behavior, published FieldLog plugin adoption and full W06 acceptance remain open.

packages.name: Guest compilation
packages.deliverables: Guest libraries, module extraction, API diagnostics, source maps, dependency closure
packages.acceptance: FieldLog feature graph compiles to native and Wasm with no silent behavior loss.
packages.remaining: Actual FieldLog baseline1587d2d model behavior matches host, physical Android and full Swift WASI development oracle. Eleven full-SDK size variants preserve sampled observations; best 52,008,982 bytes/18,852,048 gzip exceeds 3MiB budget. ICU alone accounts for 33,976,096 linked data bytes; removal is unqualified. Owned VM still rejects full artifact. Full feature/UI/effect closure, host ABI, source maps, owned Swift execution and all performance budgets remain open.

packages.name: Owned interpreter
packages.deliverables: Validator/interpreter, resource controls, imports, Swift runtime integration, debugger
packages.acceptance: D3, standards-profile tests, fuzzing and differential results.
packages.remaining: Owned bounded integer/numeric/table-memory profiles and initial C sessions have scoped physical evidence. Independent session quota race fix holds capacity until actual deallocation; 87 host tests plus release/reference/C checks pass, physical rerun pending. Typed Swift wrapper passes seven debug/release host and iOS simulator tests, cross-compiles for iOS/Android, with independent adversarial host review. Full Swift imports/resource profile, SDK/updater activation, source debugging, standards/fuzz/audit and D3 remain open.

packages.name: First-party integrations
packages.deliverables: All capability families in Section 9, plugin authoring guide
packages.acceptance: FieldLog flows pass on both devices; native additions correctly require binary changes.
packages.remaining: Bounded typed HTTP adapter hook and real app-private key-value storage implemented. Bundled HTTP network transport, remaining Section9 families, real guest integration, published FieldLog adoption and physical two-platform workflows remain open.

packages.name: Device updater
packages.deliverables: Verifier, cache, activation, health, quarantine, recovery, key rotation
packages.acceptance: D4–05, data-preserving rollback, offline recovery, fault matrix.
packages.remaining: Swift durable store and signature verifier pass host, physical Android and physical iOS app-sandbox injected-fault/recovery tests. Actual OS lifecycle/power-loss, integrated VM/native fallback, state migration, delegated key rotation and D4-D5 remain open.

packages.name: Release backend
packages.deliverables: Artifacts, compatibility, channels, assignment signing, rollout/rollback, API
packages.acceptance: Dual-platform release with immutable audit and correct cohort routing.
packages.remaining: Scoped local release API now has PostgreSQL17 tenant transactions, forced RLS, immutable audit/outbox/history, concurrent idempotency/sequence and actual local crash-recovery evidence. Independent review is in progress. Hosted identity, outbox dispatch, production durability/deployment/backup/operations and dual-platform release approval remain open.

packages.name: Build/signing service
packages.deliverables: Isolated macOS/Linux workers, caches, secrets, signer, provenance, quotas
packages.acceptance: Cross-tenant adversarial tests and signed FieldLog builds from clean workers.
packages.remaining: Full package acceptance not yet demonstrated.

packages.name: Store distribution
packages.deliverables: Store connections, submissions, status reconciliation, test links
packages.acceptance: D6 with actual ready-for-testing states on both stores.
packages.remaining: Full package acceptance not yet demonstrated.

packages.name: Console and commercial
packages.deliverables: Onboarding, permissions, SSO, release console, usage, billing, support
packages.acceptance: New organization completes full workflow through public UX/API.
packages.remaining: Full package acceptance not yet demonstrated.

packages.name: Debug/import/export
packages.deliverables: Native/guest debug, migration reports, profiler, export/ejection guide
packages.acceptance: Original source diagnostics, external app import, independent CI export build.
packages.remaining: Read-only migration hints, source export, local build and validation commands exist. Semantic import/source debug, profilers, external app migration and independent CI/export acceptance remain open.

packages.name: Security and reliability
packages.deliverables: Threat review, audit remediation, monitoring, backups, recovery drills, load tests
packages.acceptance: No unresolved launch-blocking findings; measured service objectives.
packages.remaining: Scoped cross-agent security reviews and local fault/race/differential tests run. Independent security audit, production threat/tenant/isolation review, SLO/load/backups/recovery drills remain open.

packages.name: FieldLog delivery
packages.deliverables: Real product, backend, users, both stores, continuous updates
packages.acceptance: D0–08 with independently reviewable evidence and no private escape routes.
packages.remaining: Separate native FieldLog offline iOS workflow passes isolated physical iPhone tests, including exact draft restoration and native report preview. Auth/backend/real users, photo/permission/accessibility/device/performance matrices, published Mixer adoption, Android app, store readiness and D0-D8 remain open.

packages.name: External qualification and launch
packages.deliverables: Two external apps minimum, paid pilots, docs, support, migration, release train
packages.acceptance: Section 29 gates; customers onboard and pay without bespoke engine forks.
packages.remaining: Full package acceptance not yet demonstrated.
